name: Email Auto-Reply
description: Reads an incoming support email and drafts a professional reply with an LLM. The simplest useful workflow: one model step between Start and End.

config.prompt: You are a customer support agent. Read the incoming email and write a helpful, professional reply. Be concise and friendly. Input: {{input}}

reply.example: Hi Sam, thanks for getting in touch. I have reset your password; please check your inbox.

sample_input.input: Hi, I've been trying to reset my password for 3 days and nothing is working. Please help!
